1	# WP-004: Config Parsing and Migration
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	Extend the Git credentials system from a single-token-per-host model to a multi-credential model with per-repository credential association, auto-selection for single-match hosts, and clear error surfacing for missing credentials.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Rewrite `parseGitCredentials()` in `src/config/config.ts` to accept both the old `Record<string, string>` format and the new `GitCredentialEntry[]` format, auto-migrating old entries. Update `config.dist.json` to use the new array format.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `src/config/config.ts` — rewritten `parseGitCredentials()` with migration logic
    14	- `config.dist.json` — `gitCredentials` value changed from `{}` to `[]`
    15	- `src/tests/config.test.ts` — tests for migration and validation
    16	
    17	## Deliverables
    18	
    19	- Rewritten `parseGitCredentials()` that accepts both old (`Record<string, string>`) and new (`GitCredentialEntry[]`) formats
    20	- Auto-migration logic: old entries converted to `GitCredentialEntry` with `id` derived from hostname (kebab-case, e.g., `github.com` → `github-com`), `label` set to the hostname, host and token preserved
    21	- Duplicate-ID disambiguation during migration (append numeric suffix: `-2`, `-3`, etc.)
    22	- Validation of new-format entries: non-empty required fields, valid kebab-case `id`, no duplicate IDs
    23	- Updated `config.dist.json` with `"gitCredentials": []`
    24	- Unit tests covering migration, idempotency, validation, and edge cases
    25	
    26	## Dependencies
    27	
    28	- WP-001
    29	
    30	## Acceptance Criteria
    31	
    32	1. `parseGitCredentials()` correctly migrates an old `Record<string, string>` config to `GitCredentialEntry[]`, preserving all host-token pairs.
    33	2. Migrated entries have `id` derived from the hostname in kebab-case, `label` set to the hostname value.
    34	3. Migration is idempotent — re-parsing an already-migrated array produces the same result.
    35	4. `parseGitCredentials()` rejects arrays with duplicate `id` values.
    36	5. `parseGitCredentials()` rejects entries with empty `id`, `label`, `host`, or `token` fields.
    37	6. When two old-format entries would produce the same kebab-case ID, a numeric suffix is appended to disambiguate.
    38	7. `config.dist.json` contains `"gitCredentials": []`.
    39	8. All unit tests in `src/tests/config.test.ts` for migration and validation pass.
    40	
    41	## Active Pipeline Stages
    42	
    43	`implementation` → `qa` → `security-audit` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    44	
    45	## Estimated Complexity
    46	
    47	Medium
    48	
    49	## Rationale
    50	
    51	Auto-migration was chosen over a breaking change requiring manual migration because users have existing `config.json` files and the silent migration preserves backward compatibility without requiring manual intervention. The migrated array is only persisted on the next `saveConfigField()` call, so no background rewrite occurs silently.
    52	
    53	## Rejected Approaches
    54	
    55	- Breaking change requiring manual migration — forces users to hand-edit `config.json`, which is error-prone and unnecessary.
    56	- Separate migration script — adds operational complexity; auto-migration on parse is seamless and matches the stateless-read-from-disk pattern already used by all managers.
    57	
    58	## Notes
    59	
    60	Depends on WP-001 for the `GitCredentialEntry` type. The migration only transforms the in-memory representation; the migrated array is persisted on the next `saveConfigField()` call triggered by a user action. Use `inferSlugFromUrl()` or a simple hostname-to-slug transform for ID generation.
